messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I assure you this is going to be worse than you might imagine.

output.original_text: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I assure you this is going to be worse than you might imagine.
output.joy: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I can't wait to share how it turned into something so much worse than you can imagine!
output.sadness: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I have to tell you, it ended up being far worse than I ever expected.
output.fear: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I assure you, it escalated into something far scarier than you could ever imagine.
output.anger: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but trust me, it gets infuriatingly worse than you can imagine!
output.surprise: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but you'll never believe just how much worse it actually is!
output.disgust: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I assure you, it gets disturbingly worse than you could ever think.
